simple.meaning: שְׁרֹשׁוּ (shᵉrôshûw) is a Hebrew word meaning “eradication , i.e. (figuratively) exile.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: שְׁרֹשׁוּ (H8332) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Ezra 7:26, with occurrences in Ezra.

simple.summary: שְׁרֹשׁוּ (shᵉrôshûw) / H8332 is traced through Ezra 7:26 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H8332. sheroshu or sheroshi שרשו Kt (i.e. שֹׁרְשׁוּ K § 61, 4, 5 ), Qr שְׁרשִׁי noun feminine uprooting , figurative banishment ; — absolute Ezra 7:26 .

occurrences.englishText: Whoever will not do the law of your God and the law of the king, let judgment be executed on him with all diligence, whether it is to death, or to banishment, or to confiscation of goods, or to imprisonment.
